name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Chrono Pack
summary:
A pack of 6 additional music tracks from the Chrono series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Wings That Cross Time", "Radical Dreamers -Le Trésor Interdit-", "Chrono Trigger", "Boss Battle 2", "Battle with Magus" and "Corridors of Time"
